title: Density and weekly use are counted per user, never twice
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in on the Work Orders build under test with Work Orders view permission; the Board View and Tech View display options are on.
  2. The current location has at least 3 lead technicians shown as groups/columns (a technician is eligible when they are Clockable, Active, and their role is not Office or Time Clock User).
  3. On the Work Orders QA build, seed a KNOWN set of work orders across statuses (some Approved, In Progress, Ready for Review, and some in excluded statuses) and across several lead technicians, so the header counts and the N-open dialog count can be computed by hand (Rule 14, Rule 116).
  4. Access to the analytics report; a seeded week where one user produces repeated events.
  5. AUTOMATION note: verify the counts against the raw events with engineering.
custom_steps:
1. For a seeded week, hand-count distinct users per display option and per density.
  2. Confirm weekly display usage is reported by distinct users and matches your count.
  3. Confirm the density distribution matches.
  4. Confirm a single user who produced many events is counted once (no inflation of the user denominator).
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Weekly display usage is reported by distinct users.
  • Density distribution is reported.
  • Repeated events from one user do not count that user more than once.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10043 (Work Orders — Board View & Tech View Display Options). Story reference: SV-TBD (Story 12 has no Jira story yet) — Story 12 Google Analytics for display and field usage. Spec: Confluence page 845185030 “Work Orders — Board View & Tech View Display Options (Draft Spec)”, Draft v0.9, requirement(s) S12-R4, S12-R11, S12-R13 (read 23 Sep 2026). Review decisions/answers: Confluence page 853901313 where cited. Source-verified on 23 September 2026; not yet build-verified.

  • S12-R4: “Report weekly display usage by distinct users.”
  • S12-R11: “Report density distribution.”
  • S12-R13: “Do not count repeated events from one user as additional users.”
